notes: GFPT PCL — Thailand SET-listed pure-play vertically integrated poultry. Feed mill > breeder farm > broiler > processed/cooked chicken > export. Joint venture GFN (50/50 with Nichirei Japan, processed chicken export to Japan/EU). Smaller than CPF — pure-play makes it cleaner exposure to Thai chicken cycle. FY = calendar year. Reports in THB. FY history from GFPT annual reports + SET filings via gfpt.co.th.

periods.notes: FY20: Revenue ฿14.9B (-13% YoY) on COVID export disruption; net profit ฿1.1B. Domestic broiler oversupply pressured prices.
FY21: Revenue ฿16.2B (+9%); net profit ฿685M (-38%) — corn/soy feed cost inflation squeezed margins.
FY22: Revenue ฿18.6B (+15%); net profit ฿1.37B (+100%) on chicken price recovery + Saudi/EU export reopening.
FY23: Revenue ฿18.7B flat; net profit ฿950M (-31%). Chicken oversupply + sluggish Japanese demand.
FY24: Revenue ฿19.85B (+6%); net profit ฿1.59B (+68%) — best year since 2017. Lower feed costs (corn/soy) + strong Japan/EU cooked chicken export.
